title: Room (data/rooms/<id>.json)
description: One room. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (width + depth <= 32, bounds, overlaps, known types) are checked by src/data/validate.js.

authored.description: A real game room made by the author (D90): development steps never change it or attach new rooms to it. Omitted for test rooms.

size.description: [width x, height y, depth z] in blocks; width + depth <= 32.

spawn.description: Player start (feet center) when the game starts in this room.

reset.description: Where the wizard reappears (feet center) after dying in this room, however he entered it. Defaults to "spawn" if omitted. Above the floor is fine: he falls from there like anywhere else.

blocks.description: Anonymous static blocks: plain (room color), hazard (hurts on touch) or void (kills on landing).

holes.description: Floor tiles that are pits: deadly for the player; a pushed block drops in and fills the hole.

shrine.description: Backup shrine floor tile (D97): stepping on it refills integrity, energy and backups; with no backups left the wizard reboots on the nearest one (world map distance).

objects.description: Typed objects with stable ids (types from defs.json).

enemies.description: Enemies with stable ids (templates from defs.json "enemies"); ids are shared with objects.

pickups.description: Pickups with stable ids (types from defs.json "pickups"), hovering in their cell; ids are shared with objects and enemies.

exit.description: Opening in one side of the room. Connections live in world.json.

at.description: First cell along the side (z for x sides, x for z sides).

locked.description: Closed (solid) until its switches ("switches", by default every switch in the room: targets and plates) are all on; it closes again when one goes off, but not while the wizard stands in it. Always open for the wizard when he came in through it (D75). The room needs at least one switch.

switches.description: Locked exits only (D140): the ids of the switches that open it, instead of every switch in the room.

access.description: Closed (solid) until the wizard's access level is at least this (D101); the core raises it. With "locked" too, both must be met. Always open for the wizard when he came in through it.

hidden.description: Solid wall, drawn as one, until a scan reaches it (D128); then it opens and shows (with "locked" or "access" it is a lock from then on). Revealed until the room resets; always open for the wizard when he came in through it.

type.description: A block type in defs.json "blocks" (D60): e.g. block (plain), hazard (hurts on touch), void (kills when landed on), collapsing (gives way under the wizard).

to.description: Optional opposite corner; fills the box from at to to (inclusive).
Optional opposite corner; fills the rectangle from at to to (inclusive).

overrides.description: Values that replace the type defaults for this object only. A decoration (D117) also takes "face": "+z" (the default) or "+x", the side it faces.

path.description: Required for platforms (and only allowed on them): the path they follow, starting at "at".

text.description: Screens only (D118): the id of a text in data/lore.json, shown in the wizard's terminal when he comes near.

switches.description: Gates and platforms only (D140): the ids of the switches that power it. A gate opens (a bridge appears) while they are all on, by default every switch in the room; a platform with switches runs only while they are all on and stops where it is when one goes off (without, it always runs).
Ids of switches (targets and plates) in the room (D140).

at.description: Cell it hovers in; the wizard takes it by touching that cell's middle.

template.description: Enemy template from defs.json "enemies" (D79): everything about it (D119); the room gives only its cell and path.

at.description: Spawn cell (its lower corner); it starts here whenever the room resets.

path.description: Patrol path: level (legs along x or z at the height of "at"); only x and z count once it walks, so it keeps to it after falling off a ledge. No "speed": it walks at its template's (D119). Without a path it stays put.

drop.description: Bosses only, and every boss has one (D104, D135): the id of a pickup of this room, a permanent one (no refill), that it holds until it is beaten; then the pickup shows in its cell. While its save bit is found, the boss is left out of the room.

path.description: Path shared by moving platforms and patrolling enemies: from the object's "at" through "points", each leg along one axis.

points.description: Waypoints after "at" (the object's lower corner); each differs from the one before on exactly one axis.

mode.description: pingpong: there and back; loop: from the last point straight back to "at" (also along one axis).

speed.description: Units per second; platforms only (an enemy walks at its template's speed, D119).

pause.description: Seconds of waiting at the ends: both ends of a ping-pong path, "at" on a loop.
